aggregation_definitions.area_mean: Cos(latitude)-weighted mean of finite cell values, with centers within the region. Count and observation-fraction means include unsampled zero cells.
aggregation_definitions.monthly_cell_mean: Sum(aod_weighted_mean * aod_count) / sum(aod_count) over valid three-hour cell means with positive product count; written means already include final clipping at zero.
aggregation_definitions.monthly_cell_mean_p999: NumPy linear percentile 99.9 over finite monthly cell means, equally weighted by cell; distinct from the pooled written three-hour cell-window percentile.
aggregation_definitions.paired_cell_mean_difference: Area mean of the difference of independently count-weighted period cell means, over cells finite in both runs; not a common-pixel or common-window comparison.
aggregation_definitions.southern_ocean: Configured latitude band south of 40 degrees S; includes land/island/Antarctic grid cells and is not an ocean-only surface mask.

scientific_acceptance.status: Plot protocol and visual inspection passed; numeric science acceptance remains separate and open.

notes: All 58 previews were inspected. Physical title/subtitle spacing fixes the compressed latitude-band layout; no overlaps, clipping or artificial longitude seams are visible.
The global-longitude latitude band is intentionally shallow under PlateCarree and therefore leaves white space; no background or political boundaries were added.
July ocean QA3 retains visibly fewer observations and raises the count-weighted period AOD. September mixed QA3 lowers counts and coverage, with both signs in the period-mean difference.

The nonnegative controls have zero negative fraction, with small AOD changes concentrated near land margins. This regional band includes land, so the map alone does not establish an ocean retrieval effect.
Sparse MODIS disagreement patches track locations with multiple usable streams; blank cells have no finite disagreement statistic.
Dedicated sensitivity suite directories preserve the previously accepted full-global suite reports for the same dates.
